canonical_situation: A package found on the van after dispatch belongs to a different route
normalized_description: The driver discovers after dispatch that a package on the van should have been loaded to a different van.
authoritative_rule: Delivery Status Code 012 means Package Sorted to Wrong Route and applies when a package is found on the van after dispatch but should have been loaded to a different van. OP-117 also requires a delivery notation when a package cannot be delivered. The reviewed sources do not establish the partner report's complete remove-SID-and-return sequence for this condition.
applicability: Package is physically on the driver's van
The package should have been loaded to a different van
The discrepancy is discovered after dispatch
conditions: A package that cannot be delivered receives a notation matching the recorded status
exceptions: Predispatch manifest discrepancies are outside this record
An authorized enroute transfer is a different status and workflow

required_procedure.action: Confirm that the package is on the van and belongs to a different route after dispatch.
Use Delivery Status Code 012 for the source-defined wrong-route condition.
If the package cannot be delivered, write the matching delivery notation including status code, date, and work area number.
Obtain the current station-approved disposition for custody, label handling, and return or transfer before taking further action.

required_documentation: Matching delivery notation when the package cannot be delivered
prohibited_actions: Do not present SID-sticker removal as source-verified from the cited pages
Do not substitute the predispatch Manifest Preview workflow
Do not invent a return or transfer sequence that is absent from the reviewed sources
escalation_requirements: Station or service-provider management must supply the current disposition steps not established by the reviewed sources
clarification_requirements: Was the package discovered before or after dispatch?
Is an authorized enroute transfer being arranged?

canonical_situation: A listed pickup is canceled or has no packages
normalized_description: The driver must distinguish a canceled pickup with no attempt from an attempted pickup at a closed location with no packages.
authoritative_rule: Use pickup reason 24 only for P/U Cancelled - No Attempt Made. Use pickup reason 11 only for Closed - Attempted, No Packages. For an attempted listed pickup with zero packages, FORGE uses Close (Zero Pkg), confirms zero packages, asks for the truthful reason code, and closes with DONE. The sources do not establish reason 11 for every on-site cancellation.
applicability: A listed pickup was canceled before any attempt
A listed pickup was attempted at a closed location and no packages were obtained
The listed pickup must be closed with zero packages
conditions: Reason 11 requires an attempted pickup at a closed location with no packages
The selected pickup and reason must match what actually happened
exceptions: If the driver arrived but the location was not closed, the reviewed sources do not establish that reason 11 applies merely because someone canceled
Call tags and unlisted pickups are outside this record

required_procedure.action: Determine whether no attempt was made or the pickup was attempted at a closed location with no packages.
Open the correct listed pickup and choose Close (Zero Pkg).
Confirm the Stop Close Summary shows 0 packages and continue.
Select reason 24 for a canceled pickup with no attempt, or reason 11 for a closed location that was attempted with no packages.
Select DONE to close the stop.

prohibited_actions: Do not use reason 24 after an attempt
Do not use reason 11 solely because an on-site contact says canceled when the location is not closed
Do not guess a reason code to close the stop
escalation_requirements: Ask station or service-provider management when an attempted cancellation does not match the source-defined closed/no-packages condition
clarification_requirements: Was any attempt made at the pickup location?
If attempted, was the location closed and were zero packages obtained?
driver_question_variants: I went there but the pickup was closed and had nothing
pickup canceled before I went there

must_clarify: if attempted whether the location was closed and no packages were obtained

driver_question_patterns.utterance: pickup canceled before I went there

concise_driver_answer: First determine whether you attempted the pickup. If it was canceled before any attempt, use reason 24. If you attempted it at a closed location and got no packages, use reason 11. Open the correct listed pickup, choose Close (Zero Pkg), confirm 0 packages, select the matching reason, and tap DONE. If you arrived but the location was not closed, confirm the reason with management instead of assuming code 11.
more_info_answer: This narrows the partner handoff to the exact conditions printed in MGB-119. The FORGE guide supplies the zero-package close workflow but requires the reason selected to match the real condition.

canonical_situation: A delivery package has no usable normal barcode or only a 00 barcode
normalized_description: The driver cannot scan the expected package barcode and must determine whether the special 00 key-entry contingency applies or the package must return for relabeling.
authoritative_rule: A package with no barcode is returned to the station for a replacement barcode. A 00 barcode should have a 2D or 96 primary barcode, which is scanned instead. If the 2D barcode cannot be scanned, the 20-digit 00 number may be entered using SHIFT + Scan. If no 2D or 96 barcode is present, return the package for a replacement barcode.
applicability: Delivery package lacks a normal scannable primary barcode
Delivery package displays a 00 barcode
conditions: Key entry of the 00 number applies when the accompanying 2D barcode is present but cannot be scanned
Use the 2D or 96 barcode instead of 00 when available and scannable

required_procedure.action: Inspect the package for a 2D or 96 primary barcode.
Scan the 2D or 96 barcode if present and usable.
If the accompanying 2D barcode cannot be scanned, use SHIFT + Scan to enter the 20-digit 00 number.
If no barcode exists, or a 00 barcode has no accompanying 2D or 96 barcode, retain the package and return it to the station for a replacement barcode.

prohibited_actions: Do not deliver a package with no barcode because proof of delivery will not transmit
Do not scan 00 instead of a usable primary 2D or 96 barcode
clarification_requirements: Is a 2D or 96 barcode present?
Did the 2D barcode fail to scan?
Is the 00 number 20 digits?
driver_question_variants: Can I type the tracking number

must_clarify: whether a 2D or 96 barcode is present

concise_driver_answer: Look for a 2D or 96 barcode first and scan that. If an accompanying 2D barcode is present but will not scan, press SHIFT + Scan and enter the 20-digit 00 number. If there is no barcode, or the 00 barcode has no accompanying 2D or 96 barcode, return the package to the station for a replacement barcode.
more_info_answer: This special 00-barcode contingency is not generic permission to invent or key-enter a number when the required label is absent.

canonical_situation: A listed pickup has zero packages
normalized_description: A scheduled pickup appears in the pickup listing but the shipper has no packages; stop treatment depends on whether CXPC gave advance notice or an on-site attempt occurred.
authoritative_rule: An attempted listed pickup with no packages is closed as a zero-package pickup using the truthful reason code. OP-117 distinguishes an on-site attempt with no advance notice as one stop from CXPC advance notice as zero stops.
applicability: Scheduled pickup appears in the pickup listing
Shipper has no packages to hand over
conditions: The reason code must match the actual circumstance
Advance notice from CXPC produces zero stops; an on-site attempt without advance notice produces one stop
exceptions: Call tags and unlisted pickups are outside this record

required_procedure.action: Determine whether CXPC gave advance notice or the scheduled pickup was attempted at the customer location without advance notice.
If CXPC gave advance notice, treat the result as zero stops.
For an on-site attempted listed pickup with no packages, open the correct pickup and choose Close (Zero Pkg).
Confirm the Stop Close Summary shows 0 packages, continue, select the truthful reason code, and tap DONE.

required_documentation: Truthful pickup reason code for the on-site workflow
prohibited_actions: Do not choose a reason code that does not match what happened
clarification_requirements: Is this a scheduled listed pickup?
Did CXPC provide advance notice?
Why were no packages obtained?
concise_driver_answer: First determine whether CXPC gave advance notice. Advance-notice no-package pickups count as zero stops. If you attempted the listed pickup on site without advance notice and found no packages, open the correct pickup, choose Close (Zero Pkg), confirm 0 packages, select the truthful reason, and tap DONE.
more_info_answer: The reason-code list must be interpreted using its own source-defined conditions; do not select a reason merely to close the stop.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Shows listed-pickup selection, Close (Zero Pkg), zero count, reason selection, and DONE.
Distinguishes one-stop on-site attempt without advance notice from zero-stop CXPC advance notice.

canonical_situation: FORGE hardware scan does not capture a supported barcode whose tracking ID remains readable
normalized_description: A barcode cannot be scanned because the label is damaged or the device or camera is not working, but a valid tracking ID remains visible.
authoritative_rule: FORGE Key Enter Barcode permits a readable tracking ID to be entered manually when the barcode cannot be scanned. The driver selects Free Form, EPIC, or Air Waybill to match the visible number. Invalid entries fail validation. Missing delivery labels and 00 barcodes remain governed by the separate OP-117 barcode rule.
applicability: Barcode or shipping label is damaged but the tracking ID remains readable
Device or camera cannot scan but the tracking ID remains readable
FORGE reports a check-digit validation failure
conditions: The input type must match Free Form, EPIC, or Air Waybill
A missing delivery barcode is not the same as an unscannable but readable barcode
exceptions: A package with no delivery barcode returns for a replacement barcode
A 00 barcode uses the source-defined 2D or 96 barcode contingency

required_procedure.action: Confirm the actual tracking ID is present and readable.
Open Stop Options and tap Key Enter Barcode.
Select the matching Free Form, EPIC, or Air Waybill input type.
Enter the valid visible number and tap ACCEPT.
If validation fails, scan again or enter the correct visible barcode; do not alter or invent digits.

prohibited_actions: Do not use manual entry as a substitute for a missing required delivery label
Do not change or invent barcode digits
escalation_requirements: Use the separate replacement-barcode return rule when the required delivery barcode is absent
clarification_requirements: Is the actual tracking ID present and readable?
Is the input Free Form, EPIC, Air Waybill, or the special 00 condition?

more_info_answer: A delivery package with no barcode, or the special 00-barcode condition, follows the separate OP-117 barcode rule.
